- Preferred: DUNS or company registration number, and a remit-to contact for invoices.
- PO routing: Which invoice email should we route POs to? (ap-invoices@lumenix.com or sarah.cho@lumenix.com)

2) Once we receive docs, AP team (Laura) will create the vendor master and share Vendor ID within 1 business day.
3) I’ll confirm PO routing and the invoice submission address and add the mapping to our ERP.
